finding.claim: diagrams-stay-current requires a `depicts:` front-matter field on every diagram, but OKF v0.2 does not define it and no ADR names it; ADR 0009 says any extension field other than handoff_key needs its own ADR, and okf-bundle.md restates that kmctl uses only spec fields plus ADR-named ones.

fixes.change: Diagrams list what they depict in a Depicts body section instead of a depicts front matter field, so no unnamed OKF extension field.
